## Target over time

Log equity premium over the next 1, 3, and 12 months. The shaded band is the 2016-2025 test window.

## Cumulative performance

Compounded return of each model's S&P 500 / T-bill switch over the test set. The dashed line is buy-and-hold, which is also the historical-mean strategy. The dotted line is always T-bills.

```{r performance, fig.width=11, fig.height=9}
g_perf
```
